name: home_quit
doc: Quit with the Home button (port of nxnative dm/host/home_quit.h). Holding Home for 2 s opens a prompt: A quits, B or a new press of Home closes it. Losing the focus closes whatever is shown. The buttons' memory is in three button_latch instances; see src/kit/home_quit.ts for the guards that turn button levels and time into these events.

Holding.name: since
Holding.type: f64 seconds: the time of the press that started the hold
